notes: Multi-file run on sonnet (Story 3.12): an addendum, a pre-review copy and a larger prd.md, each by one Write, then prd.md revised by three Edits. A short scripted session, not a /bmad-prd run.

turns.text:
This is a scratch project used to record a session. Use only the Write and Edit tools: no other tool, and do not read any file first. Write three Markdown files under `_bmad/prds/tidewatch/`, in this order, each with exactly one Write call:

1. `addendum.md`: an addendum of decisions and open questions for Tidewatch, an offline-first field inspection app for municipal water-main inspectors. A `# Tidewatch: Addendum` title and three `## ` sections, about 1,500 characters in all.
2. `prd.pre-review.md`: a first draft of the PRD kept as the pre-review copy. A `# Tidewatch: PRD (pre-review copy)` title and six `## ` sections, about 4,000 characters in all.
3. `prd.md`: the full PRD. A `# Tidewatch: PRD` title and ten `## ` sections (Vision, Users, Problem, Goals, Non-Goals, Functional Requirements, Non-Functional Requirements, Scope, Risks, Open Questions), about 9,000 characters in all, so it is clearly longer than both files before it.

Then revise `prd.md` with three separate Edit calls, one after another: tighten one sentence in Vision; add one numbered requirement to Functional Requirements; add a new `## Success Metrics` section just before `## Risks`. Do not touch the other two files after writing them. When done, reply with one short sentence.
